steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each obligation is placed by whether it is done, overdue or unowned.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 obligation is overdue and not marked done

findings.title: Obligation past its due date not marked done
findings.fix: Confirm whether it was done and record it

outcome.notChecked: Obligations not extracted; whether the party performed.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] oblig-lease-rent.md:12  Obligation past its due date not marked done.
       Fix: Confirm whether it was done and record it.
[medium] oblig-insurance.md:19  Obligation with no owner role.
       Fix: Assign an owner role.
[low] oblig-notice.md:26  Obligation with no clause reference.
       Fix: Cite the clause.
Not checked: Obligations not extracted; whether the party performed.
pros: Checks an obligation with no clause reference, an obligation past its due date that is not marked done, and an obligation with no owner role.
cons: Not checked: Obligations not extracted; whether the party performed.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-obligations-tracker skill on the records for this review.
